summary: Lixiang Education Holding filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual general meeting held September 18, 2026. Shareholders ratified Audit Alliance LLP as auditor and approved the audited fiscal 2025 and 2024 financials. They also approved a proposed share issuance of 20 billion Class A and 5 billion Class B ordinary shares for aggregate consideration of US$12.5 million, plus a capital reduction and share sub-division. A related Form F-1 resale registration and CSRC filing are contemplated; no board recommendation or advisor was named. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation.
